d: Albilad Holding Company is a Jeddah-based group providing logistics services, equipment rental, and trading solutions to individuals and businesses across Saudi Arabia. As we expand, we are building a capable, high-integrity team to support our next stage of growth.

We are hiring an Accountant to manage day-to-day accounting across our logistics services, equipment rental, and trading operations. The role's priorities are cost center accounting, fixed asset accounting, and independently completing the month-end close. You will work with the operations team to ensure costs are recorded accurately and give management a clear view of profitability across each business activity.
q: Bachelor's degree in Accounting or Finance.
3–5 years of accounting experience, including at least 2 years handling the month-end close independently.
Hands-on experience maintaining cost centers, allocating shared expenses, and managing fixed asset records.
Demonstrated ability to prepare financial reports for management.
Practical knowledge of Saudi VAT and ZATCA e-invoicing requirements.
Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and accounting software. Experience with Zoho Books is an advantage.
Good command of Arabic and English, written and spoken.
Experience in logistics, equipment rental, trading, or a company with multiple business activities.
Knowledge of IFRS and Zakat filing.

Integrity, honesty, and professional credibility are essential. We expect you to safeguard confidential financial information, maintain records that can be independently verified, and promptly report discrepancies or irregular transactions.
r: Cost centers and profitability. Set up and maintain cost centers by business activity. Assign direct costs to the appropriate centers, allocate shared expenses using documented methods, and report revenue, costs, and margins by activity and, where relevant, by trip, job, or equipment unit.

Fixed assets. Maintain the fixed asset register for trucks, trailers, and equipment. Record acquisitions, transfers, depreciation, and disposals. Distinguish capital expenditure from routine repairs and maintenance, reconcile the register to the general ledger, and investigate differences identified during physical asset counts.

Month-end close and reporting. Complete the close independently, including accruals, prepayments, and account reconciliations. Deliver the income statement, balance sheet, and cash flow summary on schedule, and explain significant variances to management.

Day-to-day accounting. Maintain the general ledger, reconcile bank and cash accounts and customer and supplier balances, verify invoices against supporting documents, follow up on overdue receivables, and prepare supplier payment schedules.

VAT, e-invoicing, and controls. Reconcile VAT accounts, prepare supporting schedules for VAT returns, apply ZATCA e-invoicing requirements, and maintain complete records and approvals for audit and review.
x: Direct exposure to senior management and a real role in building the finance function of a growing group
Apply through LinkedIn with your updated CV. Priority will be given to candidates whose CVs show what they handled directly in cost allocation, fixed asset reconciliations, and month-end reporting.

d: Join Our Front Office Team as a Guest Service Agent at the First Vignette Collection in KSA!

We are looking for a welcoming, energetic, and detail-oriented Guest Service Agent to be the first point of contact and the face of the First Vignette Collection in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia (Carlton Al Moaibed Hotel). This is a pivotal role for individuals passionate about creating exceptional, personalized experiences and launching a successful career in luxury hospitality. If you have a passion for people and a commitment to service excellence, we encourage you to join our dynamic team.
Primary Responsibilities: Guest Check-in/Check-out: Efficiently manage the guest registration and departure process, ensuring accuracy and providing a seamless, memorable experience.
Customer Service: Warmly welcome guests, anticipate their needs, and respond promptly and courteously to all inquiries, requests, and concerns, escalating issues when necessary.
Information Hub: Provide in-depth knowledge of hotel services, facilities, local attractions, and dining options, acting as a personal concierge for guests.
Cash and Billing Handling: Accurately process payments, post charges, prepare folios, and handle currency exchange according to hotel financial procedures.
Communication & Coordination: Maintain clear and consistent communication with other departments (Housekeeping, F&B, Maintenance) to ensure all guest requests are fulfilled promptly.
Telephone Operations: Manage the hotel switchboard, directing calls, taking messages, and handling wake-up call requests with professionalism.
Safety & Security: Be aware of and follow all safety and security procedures to ensure a safe environment for guests and colleagues.
Requirements: Education: High school diploma or equivalent; a degree or diploma in Hospitality Management or a related field is a plus.

Experience: Previous experience in a customer-facing role, preferably within a hotel front office, luxury retail, or customer service environment, is an advantage, but passionate fresh graduates are welcome to apply.
Technical Skills: Proficiency in MS Office Suite; working knowledge of Property Management Systems (PMS) such as Opera is highly desirable.
Communication: Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English are essential. Fluency in Arabic is a significant advantage; proficiency in a third language is a bonus.
Presentation & Demeanor: Impeccable personal presentation and a professional, friendly, and calm demeanor, even during peak operational times.
Attributes: A genuine passion for delivering exceptional customer service, a high level of empathy, and strong problem-solving skills.
Availability: Must be flexible to work shifts, including evenings, weekends, and public holidays, as part of a 24/7 operation.
